title: A Swedish company is transforming discarded wind turbines into tiny-solar powered homes and recycled skis
summary_full: The challenge of decommissioned wind turbine blades is becoming increasingly prominent in Europe. The composite materials used in these blades are notoriously difficult to recycle, leading to significant landfill concerns. In response, various companies are working on inventive reuse projects that could transform these retired assets into valuable materials, underscoring the necessity for a regulatory structure that supports sustainable initiatives in this industry.
